remarks:
7080 State Route 305, Belfast, NY
Ranch Home on 4.7 Acres | Belfast, Allegany County, NY

Opportunity awaits with this 1,542 square foot craftsmen-built ranch home situated on 4.7 scenic acres in the Town of Belfast, New York. The property features a drilled well, septic system, electric service, and a primarily wood-heated residence that is approximately 80% complete—offering the next owner a unique chance to finish the home to their own tastes and specifications.

Outside, you'll find a horse barn with four stalls, water spigot, fenced pasture and wooded acreage, along with an additional storage shed. The mostly wooded lot provides privacy and wildlife habitat, while a small creek winds through the property below. The home overlooks the stream, creating a peaceful setting with attractive country views.

Whether you're looking for a recreational getaway, hobby farm, horse property, hunting camp, or full-time residence, this property offers tremendous potential.

Belfast is a charming rural community located in the heart of Allegany County, known for its rolling hills, agricultural heritage, and outdoor recreation opportunities. The area is popular with hunters, anglers, horseback riders, and outdoor enthusiasts seeking a quieter pace of life while remaining within reach of larger cities.

Recreational opportunities abound nearby:

The renowned Genesee River is just minutes away, offering fishing, kayaking, and wildlife viewing.
Rushford Lake provides boating, fishing, swimming, and seasonal recreation approximately 15 minutes from the property.
Cuba Lake, one of Western New York's premier inland lakes, is also within a short drive and offers additional boating and waterfront dining opportunities.
Thousands of acres of public hunting land can be found nearby, including portions of the Allegheny region and numerous New York State forests.
The area is well known for exceptional whitetail deer, turkey, and small game hunting.
Letchworth State Park, often called the "Grand Canyon of the East," is approximately 30 minutes away and offers hiking, waterfalls, rafting, and year-round outdoor activities.
